name: Happy Co. (2nd Position)
desc:
Call Handling Specialist | $21/hr to start | Inbound Calls, No Sales Expectations
Company: HappyCo
Industry: Customer Service

What Your Day Will Look Like:
HappyCo makes software that apartment and property companies use to manage their properties, and their Happy Force team handles maintenance issues for residents. In this role, you answer live calls from residents, property staff, and vendors about maintenance problems. You'll follow scripts and step-by-step workflows to figure out what's going on, type clear notes into the system while you talk, and escalate true emergencies right away. For basic problems, you'll use troubleshooting guides to help the caller over the phone. You'll keep residents and property teams in the loop, stay calm with upset callers, and join short daily huddles. Calls are measured on response time, documentation, and quality audits.

Soft Skills
- Calm, patient tone with upset callers
- Active listening
- Empathy
- Organization and attention to detail
- Following procedures consistently
assessment: Expect a basic assessment, a typing test, and a home internet speed test, since the posting doesn't state otherwise. Worth noting the posting also mentions AI tools may be used to review applications and responses.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: Not listed. The posting says they welcome applicants of any educational background.
Required Experience: 3+ years of property management experience
Preferred Experience: Customer service, call center, or maintenance coordination experience. Basic knowledge of property maintenance terms. Bilingual Spanish is preferred.

Required Skills:
- Strong verbal communication and active listening
- Able to type notes while talking with a caller
- Comfortable with computers, web-based software, and call tools
- Empathy, patience, and professionalism
- Understanding of how residents, property management, and maintenance staff work together
- Upbeat, outgoing, and wants to help people
- Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has 3+ years in apartment or property management, like a leasing or office role
- Stays calm and clear when a resident is stressed about a leak or outage
- Likes structured work with scripts and clear steps
- Speaks Spanish as well as English

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has less than 3 years of property management experience
- Doesn't want to be on the phone all day
- Struggles to type and listen at the same time
- Prefers to improvise rather than follow scripts and procedures
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process. HappyCo may use AI tools to help review applications.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Property management
- Call handling
- Maintenance coordination
- Work order documentation
- Emergency escalation
- Resident relations
- Inbound customer service
- SOP and script adherence
- Active listening
- Bilingual Spanish

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your property management experience and the kinds of resident issues you handled.
- A resident calls saying water is coming through the ceiling. Walk us through what you'd do.
- How do you keep good notes while still listening closely to the caller?
- Tell us about a time you calmed down an upset resident or customer. What was the situation, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you had to follow a strict procedure under pressure. What happened, what did you do, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $21/hr to start. Full-time, non-exempt, so overtime eligible.
-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage.
-Benefits: Paid vacation and sick time, a work-from-home stipend, and company-subsidized healthcare, provided through TCW.
-Equipment Provided: Not stated. The posting only lists reliable internet and a quiet workspace. HappyCo's Virtual Maintenance Technician role requires workers to use their own computer, so participants should ask about equipment in the screen.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: This is a good fit for someone with property management experience who wants to work from home and use what they already know. HappyCo uses TCW as its employer of record, so pay and benefits run through TCW while you work on HappyCo's Happy Force team. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Call Handling Specialist → Senior Call Handling Specialist → Happy Force Lead → Property Operations Support Manager. This role builds triage, maintenance coordination, and documentation skills.
